script_text: Stop — Pisces, Neptune is pressing down on your natal Sun and the stars refuse to let you look away. Saturn is forming a difficult square to Neptune in your 1st House of Identity, creating a thick fog that clouds your instincts and second-guesses your decisions. The water element flowing through you is stagnant today, so don't trust every impulse. Venus in your 7th House of Partnerships is sextile Jupiter, pulling a past connection back toward you — if single, this energy attracts someone genuine; if taken, an unspoken tension needs addressing before it grows. Pluto activates your 10th House of Career, signaling a power shift at work — claim your authority rather than retreating. A sudden financial gift tied to a creative project is coming your way — accept it without hesitation. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss what the cosmos has planned for Pisces next.
